cards.text: Jesus is up on the mountain, teaching His disciples (Matthew 5:1-2). He just told them to give, pray and fast in secret, and their Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward them (Matthew 6:1-18). Now He says, 'Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth…' and friend, I'm already leaning in.

cards.question: Jesus says not to store up treasures on earth. What's the problem with treasure kept down here?

answers.text: Moth and rust destroy it and thieves steal it
Tax collectors come and take half of it
Kings seize it to pay their armies

cards.text: Then Jesus says to store up treasures in heaven instead, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal. Friend, I came out of a clearance bin for 25 cents, and NO thief was ever breaking in for me.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says your heart ends up wherever your treasure is.

cards.text: Then Jesus changes the picture and says the eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says bad eyes leave only part of the body in darkness.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, 'If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!' That's the power going out and your flashlight clicking on to... NOTHING.
Ever had two managers text you opposite orders at the exact same time, friend? Jesus says no one can serve two masters.

cards.question: Jesus says no one can serve two masters. What does He say happens to the one who tries?

answers.text: He'll love one and hate the other
He'll get worn out by both of them
He'll end up working for neither

cards.question: Jesus has been talking about treasure. Then He lands it: you cannot serve both God and ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, 'Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear.' Friend, you know that 2 a.m. ceiling stare, running the bill math for the FOURTH time like the numbers might change their mind?

cards.question: Right after saying don't worry, Jesus asks a question about food and clothes. What's His point?

answers.text: Life and body are worth more than food and clothes
Food and clothes are a waste of money
Fasting matters more than eating ever will

cards.text: Then Jesus says to look at the birds of the air: they do not sow or reap or gather into barns. Not ONE bird out there has a retirement plan, friend.

cards.question: The birds don't sow, reap or gather into barns. So how does Jesus say they eat?

answers.text: They take from the farmers' barns
They fly to wherever fields are full

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says the birds are worth more than you are.

cards.text: Then Jesus asks, 'Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?' Friend, I spent years worrying in the back of a junk drawer, and the only thing it ever added was dust.
Then He turns to clothes: 'Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.' Those flowers never sewed a single stitch, and they STILL show up dressed for a wedding.

cards.question: Jesus brings up Solomon, the king of Israel who outdid every king on earth in riches (1 Kings 10:23). True or false: Jesus says Solomon in all his glory was dressed better than one of these lilies.

cards.text: Here's the thing about those flowers: they're grass of the field, here today, and tomorrow thrown into the furnace. Gorgeous. And gone.

cards.question: If that's how God clothes the grass that's gone tomorrow, Jesus asks, will He not much more ___ you?

cards.text: Then Jesus calls them, 'O you of little faith,' and tells them not to worry, saying, 'What shall we eat?' or 'What shall we drink?' or 'What shall we wear?' Friend, that's three questions on repeat, like a song stuck in your head that you don't even LIKE.

cards.question: Jesus says the Gentiles strive after food, drink and clothes. What does He say your heavenly Father knows?
Jesus doesn't stop at telling them not to worry. What does He say to seek first?

answers.text: The kingdom of God and His righteousness
The treasures of earth and their glory
The favor of men and their praise

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says that when you seek God's kingdom first, food, drink and clothes will all be added to you.

cards.text: Then Jesus wraps it up: do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Nobody clocks in for Friday's shift on a Monday, friend.

cards.question: Jesus says not to worry about tomorrow, because today has enough ___ of its own.

cards.text: That's this batch out of the oven, friend. But Jesus is still up on that mountain, and He's got more to say.
